name: swoole/library-embedded-tests
description: Installs the test tooling for running the test suite against the library embedded in the Swoole extension (swoole.enable_library=On). The main composer.json cannot be used there: its autoload rules would redeclare the functions and classes the extension already provides. Swoole\Grpc is the exception: it is a Composer-only component that is not packed into the extension, so it needs its own PSR-4 rule here as well. Used by the Build Swoole workflow as: COMPOSER=composer-embedded.json composer update
